headline: Khaitan & Co acts on Carbon Resources - Druk Green Power Corp 104MW hydropower project in Bhutan

detail: Carbon Resources Private Limited has entered into a strategic joint venture with Druk Green Power Corporation, the state-owned hydropower company of Bhutan, for the development and operation of the 104MW Dangchhu Hydropower Project in Bhutan. Khaitan & Co acted as the legal counsel to Carbon Resources, advising and assisting the Company on drafting, negotiation, finalisation and execution of definitive agreements relating to the transaction. The transaction team consisted of Shourya Sengupta (Partner), Sneh Lata (Counsel) and Karishma Sethia (Senior Associate). Shourya Sengupta The Dangchhu project is expected to contribute to Bhutan’s energy security and sustainable economic growth.
